Public (unauthenticated) preview so the landing page can show what the
link grants *before* Google sign-in. Reveals kind, trial/opt-out length,
validity, and the label (prospect-facing copy on the deal card) — never
redemption internals. Rate-limited: this is a code-validity oracle. The
slowapi decorator buckets per path (per guessed code), so unknown-code
lookups additionally burn a cross-path per-IP budget.

Redeem an activation code: grant the caller's org a time-boxed inference
trial. Idempotent per (code, org) — re-clicking neither double-counts nor
re-extends.
